# Incidentaloma Phenotyping 

## DHEA-S Testing

Serum dehydroepiandrosterone sulfate (DHEA-S) results were extracted from the electronic health record for all genotyped participants in the Penn Medicine BioBank (PMBB). A total of 10,195 results from 7,647 participants were identified. We excluded results reported in units other than µg/dL and results that were non-numeric, leaving 9,420 results from 7,191 participants. For participants with multiple measurements, the maximum value was used. Participants with a maximum DHEA-S > 600 µg/dL, a threshold [reference], were classified as DHEA-S positive and excluded from downstream analysis.
